Analysts see positive catalysts, including a new CEO and better earnings expectations, as crucial for its recovery and valuation.

items.title: India’s operational data centre capacity on track to reach 2 GW by the end of the year
items.summary: India's data centre market added about 130 MW of new capacity in H1 2026 and expects more growth. The total operational capacity is projected to reach 2 GW by the end of the year. Mumbai continues to dominate this expansion and accounts for almost all new supply added. Over USD 38 billion in investment commitments were made during the first half of the year.

items.title: FirstCry-backed Swara Baby Products gets Sebi nod for Rs 1,000 crore IPO
items.summary: Swara Baby Products has received approval from Sebi to proceed with its Rs 1,000 crore IPO. The IPO includes a fresh issue of equity shares and an offer for sale by promoters. Proceeds will be used for expanding a manufacturing facility and repaying borrowings among other corporate purposes. Founded in 2018, Swara Baby manufactures a range of disposable hygiene products for different consumer needs.

items.title: Stock market prediction for tomorrow: Sensex, Nifty outlook for Wednesday | Kospi, Taiwan cues to watch | 7 Oct 2026
items.summary: The Indian stock market showed positive momentum on October 6, with the Nifty 50 and Sensex both gaining 0.72%. The rally was supported by banks and global sentiment, as attention shifted to the upcoming RBI policy decision on interest rates.

items.title: Karnataka liquor volumes flat in H1 as beer gets three cheers
items.summary: Karnataka observed significant growth in beer sales, rising by 41% in the first half of the fiscal year. Indian-made liquor sales, however, remained stable with a mere 1% increase during the same period. Revenue from beer and Indian-made liquor combined reached Rs 22,192 crore, reflecting a 13% growth year-on-year. Domestic liquor manufacturers had concerns regarding the regulatory framework that affected consumption patterns.

items.title: World Bank flags oil, El Niño and global market risks to growth
items.summary: The World Bank has revised its growth forecast for South Asia, projecting a robust 6.9% by 2026, driven by a surge in consumer demand. India, leading the region's economy, is expected to achieve a 7.1% growth. However, persistent high inflation and potential spikes in energy prices pose risks to this growth.

items.title: Barbie maker Mattel faces investor pressure to consider a sale amid stagnating growth
items.summary: Mattel is facing pressure from a major investor to consider a sale amid struggling sales and profitability, according to various reports on Monday.

items.title: Markets may remain cautious in near term, but long-term outlook positive: Anand Rathi’s Pradeep Gupta
items.summary: Gupta said domestic economic fundamentals remain strong, with real GDP growth at 7.8% in the first quarter, while private capital investment has also started picking up

items.title: Global Market: Eurozone energy inflation has yet to spread to broader prices, ECB's Rehn says
items.summary: Eurozone energy inflation has not yet spread broadly to other goods and services, ECB policymaker Olli Rehn said. Rising bond yields may curb economic growth and limit price pressures, though resilient activity and AI investment remain concerns. Markets expect further ECB rate hikes as policymakers balance persistent inflation against tightening financial conditions.

items.title: House China committee chair urges Fed to review Hong Kong’s access to dollar lifeline
items.summary: Rep. John Moolenaar wants the Fed to rethink Hong Kong’s access to a dollar-liquidity facility as China promotes the renminbi as a global currency.

items.title: India’s cybersecurity startups face a new hurdle: proving they can protect customers
items.summary: Enterprises are moving beyond security certifications to scrutinize how cybersecurity startups protect data, control access and respond to breaches, lengthening sales and onboarding cycles.

items.title: Supreme Court stay lifts Tata Chemicals off day’s low
items.summary: Tata Chemicals informed BSE and NSE that the Supreme Court has restrained the Government of Gujarat and others from taking any coercive action against the company in an ongoing land-rights case

items.title: S&P sees 12-14% credit growth in India despite rural stress risks
items.summary: S&P has projected credit growth of 12-14% in India's financial sector, emphasizing concerns about rural credit growth. The potential impact of weak monsoons on agricultural earnings could further exacerbate credit challenges. Economic activity exhibits resilience, supported by strong capital positions of banks and lenders. Public investment remains steady while private investment focuses on specific sectors, showing improvement. Inflation is projected at 5.1% for FY27, amidst challenges from global factors.

items.title: RPSG Group weighs 15-20% stake sale in IPL team Lucknow Super Giants
items.summary: RPSG is seeking a valuation of $1.5 billion to $2 billion for the Lucknow franchise, which it acquired for $800 million in November 2021.

items.title: Student riots engulf France as far-right presidential frontrunner Le Pen vows fiscal turnaround
items.summary: A teenager reportedly lost a hand in the protests, which have seen over 5,000 people arrested.

items.title: Women account for over 57% of online medical consultations through eSanjeevani
items.summary: The eSanjeevani platform has reached a significant milestone of 50 crore teleconsultations across India. It shows notable participation, with 57.14 percent of users being women and 40.15 percent aged 46 and above. Telemedicine is proving essential in enhancing healthcare access for citizens in remote areas. The service has expanded rapidly and supports a diverse range of medical consultations daily.

items.title: Cabinet approves new authority to enhance R&D across transportation and logistics
items.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved the creation of an Integrated Transport & Logistics Authority to improve synergy. This new authority aims to enhance planning and evaluation processes across India's transportation sector. It will be responsible for appraising significant infrastructure projects and developing the National Transport Master Plan. Additionally, the ITLA will integrate essential data for effective project planning and monitor major transport projects.

items.title: Campa vs FSSAI: Reliance wins Delhi court relief against 'energy drink' label ban
items.summary: Campa v FSSAI: Delhi Court allowed Mukesh Ambani's Reliance Industries to continue marketing its Campa brand products as ‘energy drinks’

items.title: IHG signs deal for 130-key voco hotel in Vrindavan, opening planned for 2031
items.summary: IHG Hotels & Resorts has finalized a management agreement with Vrindam Developers for a new hotel. The voco Vrindavan will feature 130 keys and is expected to open in the first quarter of 2031. This development represents Vrindam Developers' first venture into the hospitality sector, expanding their business portfolio. IHG currently operates 53 hotels in India and has plans for 110 more in the upcoming years.

items.title: Federation of Indian Airlines seeks review of existing ATF pricing formula
items.summary: The Federation of Indian Airlines highlighted the significant impact of rising jet fuel costs on airline operations. They emphasized that current pricing formulas are insufficient due to ongoing geopolitical issues and currency fluctuations. The FIA requested a shift to a 'Cost Plus' pricing model for Aviation Turbine Fuel. They also noted the need for government support to maintain affordable air travel for passengers.

items.title: Cabinet approves Rs 10,000 crore SME Growth Fund for small and medium enterprises
items.summary: The Union Cabinet approved a Rs 10,000 crore SME Growth Fund to support micro, small, and medium enterprises. This fund is part of the government's initiative to create champion MSMEs in India. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman outlined various measures to enhance liquidity support and accessibility to risk capital. Additionally, the government allocated Rs 24,566.27 crore to the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises.

items.title: India may average 7.2% growth this fiscal despite H2 slowdown, potential seen at 8%, says economist
items.summary: India's economic growth is expected to slow down below 7 percent in the upcoming quarters. Despite this moderation, the overall growth for the year may average around 7.2 percent. Economist Madan Sabnavis indicates potential for long-term growth reaching 8 percent in the coming years. Global uncertainties and local consumption impacts are significant factors influencing this outlook.

items.title: Global Market: AMD to increase AI chip supply substantially in 2027 to meet rising demand
items.summary: AMD plans to substantially increase chip supplies in 2027 as demand for AI processors accelerates. CEO Lisa Su is working with key suppliers in Taiwan and South Korea to expand manufacturing and secure advanced wafer and memory capacity.

JioStar launched 'Beyond Boundaries' to enhance advertiser partnerships with regional-language programming. The Telugu feed experienced the highest digital watch time growth at 30%. The initiative highlights various successful regional programming that connects with local audiences. JioStar aims to capitalize on the increased interest in regional-language cricket viewership.

items.title: Experion Developers plans Rs 10,000 crore investment to build 3,000 luxury homes, plots in 5 years
items.summary: Experion Developers, an Indian real estate platform, plans to invest Rs 10,000 crore in luxury homes. The investment will facilitate the development of approximately 3000 homes and plots over five years. Most of the projects will be located in the National Capital Region, with others in Amritsar, Lucknow, and Goa. The focus of the developments will center around wellness and environmentally responsible construction methods.

items.title: Global Market: European shares rally as healthcare gains offset eurozone fiscal concerns
items.summary: European shares climbed to near one-week highs, led by healthcare stocks, while easing eurozone bond yields offered some relief. Investors remained focused on fiscal pressures, political uncertainty and upcoming economic data for clues on the region’s outlook.

items.summary: Nuvama Institutional Equities maintains a positive outlook on the auto sector, with key picks including Hyundai Motor, Tata Motors, and Eicher Motors. They anticipate 27% revenue growth driven by industry volumes, although EBITDA growth may be limited to 10% due to cost pressures.

items.title: Insurance brokers oppose IRDAI's proposed reforms on caps on commissions
items.summary: Indian insurance brokers are opposing regulatory proposals that include caps on commissions paid to various distributors. The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India introduced these proposals to reduce costs for policyholders. Concerns have been raised about potential job losses and unethical practices following the reforms. The brokers association has requested an audience with government leaders regarding the changes.

items.title: LIC mints Rs 531 crore in one day as Trent shares rally 13%; insurance behemoth’s stake value nears Rs 4,700 cr
items.summary: Trent shares rose sharply after a strong Q2 business update, adding over Rs 17,540 crore to its market capitalisation. The surge lifted the value of LIC’s stake in the Zudio parent by more than Rs 531 crore in a single session. Trent also crossed 1,000 Zudio stores during the quarter.

items.title: Dabur shares rise 4% as firm sees double-digit Q2 growth; FMCG set for strong performance
items.summary: Dabur shares rose sharply on Tuesday after the FMCG major projected double-digit consolidated revenue and PAT growth in Q2FY27. Its India FMCG business is expected to accelerate, while Home & Personal Care could post double-digit growth. Food and Beverages may deliver mid-teens growth, while international business is expected to maintain strong momentum.

items.summary: Oil markets remain on edge over potential Middle East supply disruptions, with Brent trading around $100 a barrel as the risk of further escalation persists.

items.title: Global Market: Gulf oil flows rebound to 81% of pre-war levels in September
items.summary: Gulf oil flows excluding Iran recovered to 81% of pre-war levels in September, supported by a sharp rebound in Saudi Arabian exports. Crude and condensate shipments reached 91% of pre-war levels, while refined fuel exports remained weaker. Volatile daily flows, however, raise questions over the sustainability of the recovery.

items.summary: Manufacturing sentiment in India improved noticeably in the second quarter of FY27, reflecting increased expectations for production and demand. About 95 percent of manufacturers reported stable or higher production levels compared to the previous quarter. Capacity utilization also rose, reaching approximately 75 percent, highlighting effective operational efficiency. Hiring intentions increased, with 43 percent of manufacturers planning to recruit additional staff in the coming months.

items.title: PwC’s new India consulting JV signals bigger global role for India
items.summary: PwC is putting India at the centre of its global consulting strategy by combining its India consulting business with the US firm’s India advisory operations into a nearly 40,000-person joint venture. Executives said the move is aimed at routing more global consulting work through India, expanding work with GCCs and giving Indian clients greater access to PwC’s global capabilities, rather than simply cutting costs.

Khan is seeking to restrain the release and dissemination of the film, which he claims infringes on his personality rights.

items.title: How AI is transforming India’s BPM industry
items.summary: India's business process management landscape is remarkably transforming as it embraces artificial intelligence and smarter operations. This change signifies a shift away from age-old cost-centric models, aiming instead for tangible business results via cutting-edge technology. Leaders within the industry highlight the importance of novel workflow strategies, necessitating advanced skills and compliance mechanisms. With AI's growing presence, workforce roles are set to adapt, emphasizing critical decision-making and oversight.

items.title: Private equity inflows into Indian real estate jump 23% to $2.7 billion in H1 FY27
items.summary: Private equity investment in Indian real estate surged to USD 2.7 billion in H1 FY27. Domestic investors contributed significantly, deploying USD 1.3 billion across various deals. The office asset class continues to gather attention, attracting 35% of total investments. Investment trends indicate a shift towards new-age assets, particularly data centres, which showcased considerable growth. Overall, investor confidence improved, showcasing a clear recovery and commitment to the Indian real estate market.

items.summary: Infosys will announce its Q2 FY27 results on October 22-23, with the board meeting to approve the financials for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. An interim dividend may also be considered. Market focus will be on revenue growth and AI impacts.

items.summary: The Bank of Japan may signal later this month that underlying inflation has reached its 2% target, strengthening expectations for a December rate hike. items.summary: The Centre has introduced 375 new permissible works under the Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission. The categories include water security, core rural infrastructure, livelihood-related infrastructure, and disaster preparedness. An emphasis has been placed on livelihood infrastructure, with 128 works focused on water security. The revised framework replaces MGNREGA with guaranteed wage employment for rural households each year.

items.title: Lupin launches fixed-dose triple combination inhaler for COPD in India
items.summary: Lupin Ltd has launched Formoflo-G MDI, a new inhaler for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease management in India. This fixed-dose inhaler combines three therapies into a single device for better treatment outcomes. It aims to benefit over 55 million people living with COPD across the country. The Drug Controller General of India has approved this innovative product for use. Lupin is currently ranked second in the respiratory therapy segment in India.

items.title: SRIT India shares hit 5% upper circuit after strong debut, jump 19% from IPO price. Should you buy, sell or hold?

With the company’s digital technology services business gaining traction, analysts highlight revenue growth, profitability, execution and cash flows as key factors for investors.

items.title: Ambani’s Jio said to seek about Rs 11 lakh crore valuation in IPO
items.summary: Jio Platforms is reportedly seeking a valuation of around Rs 11 lakh crore for its planned IPO, below earlier estimates of up to $170 billion. The telecom and digital services arm of Reliance Industries could launch the issue in the week of October 19 and list before October 30, Bloomberg reported.

items.title: GST 2.0: From stuck tax credit to fewer disputes, industry chambers list key reform demands
items.summary: GST 2.0 reforms are being advocated by industry chambers to improve input tax credit and streamline compliance processes. Businesses desire changes that would expedite refunds, broaden ITC eligibility, and reduce litigation issues. A more automated GST system is sought to alleviate working capital constraints and simplify registration and returns for small businesses. Real estate developers also seek clarity on ITC and faster credit releases to enhance project viability.

items.title: Trev plans 2,500-vehicle premium EV fleet by 2031, raising $2 million
items.summary: Aiming to elevate its electric vehicle fleet from 105 to 300 by the close of the financial year, Trev Mobility is in the process of raising $2 million, having almost reached $1 million in funding thus far. With its fleet comprising deluxe electric vehicles, Trev offers distinct services outside mainstream ride-hailing markets.

items.title: Orient Cables shares tumble 10% a day after strong market debut
items.summary: Orient Cables' shares faced a notable drop of 10% soon after a promising IPO launch, leading to a dip in investor sentiment. However, the stock continues to hold firm above the initial issue price of Rs 272. Analysts are now focused on the firm’s capability to maintain revenue growth and its profitability, urging investors to carefully evaluate its financial soundness and operational strategies in the near future.

items.title: Dabur India expects double-digit revenue growth in Q2 FY27
items.summary: Dabur India anticipates strong double-digit growth in its consolidated revenues and India FMCG business for the upcoming quarter.
